title: Golf Advisory Committee
summary: Sep 8, at 2pm, in South Hall Board Room
public_detail: Golf Course Maintenance Report - Submitted by Randy Mitchell & Joe Clay, Superintendent -- Work on sandtraps - New trap by the 1st green is completed;  sand was added by the 3rd & 5th green;  the new sod for the greens will be installed next week;  this sod will be used to replace the infected spots on all greens; no future need to buy sod from the sod farm, will be growing our own; there will be sand located in the parking lot that is going to be placed on the golf course. -- All shrubs & weeds were removed from the west side of the Pro Shop;  new ground cover and some low growing plants will be added;  On the south side of the Pro Shop, weeds and plants will be removed and replaced with lower maintenance plants;  new sprinklers have been installed by the 1st green.
